The [DLR cycle counters](dlr-counters.qmd) page charts every one of the council's permanent bike counters, by month, by time of year and by day of the week, and updates itself when the council publishes new data.

Some of the routes that Google Maps and the councils show as cycle routes are hard or impossible to cycle: a path that turns into a stony beach, or a walled lane too narrow for two bikes to pass. Each one breaks a route that is otherwise good, and pushes people back onto busy roads or off their bikes.

This project documents those gaps, and the routes I cycle regularly, one at a time, with photos taken on the ground, what the map claims, and what the council has said or planned. Each page ends with questions for Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council (DLR). Pages are updated when there's news.

:::{#pieces}
:::

## Where things stand

Last checked 8 November 2026.

| Route | Status |
|---|---|
| [Blackrock DART laneway](blackrock-dart-laneway.qmd) | Approved 2024, no objections to the land purchase, construction not yet scheduled |
| [Shankill to Killiney](shankill-killiney.qmd) | Google Maps shows a bike lane on a shingle beach |
| [Coastal Mobility Route](coastal-mobility-route.qmd) | Still temporary; permanent version backed in 2023, not yet built |
| [Rock Road to Merrion Gates](rock-road-merrion-gates.qmd) | Built to Trimleston Avenue in 2023; gap to Merrion Gates on the city side |
| [Lower Kilmacud Road](kilmacud-road-lower.qmd) | DLR Connector due to go for planning; construction 2027–28 |
| [Dún Laoghaire Central](dun-laoghaire-central.qmd) | Finished October 2026, snagging in November |
| [Blackrock village](blackrock-village.qmd) | Works until early 2027; contraflow reported closed |
| [Stillorgan village](stillorgan-village.qmd) | Old Dublin Road phase delayed to 2027 |

How many people cycle each route is on the [DLR cycle counters](dlr-counters.qmd) page, which updates when the council publishes new data.

Spotted a gap that should be here? Email [fianaise@proton.me](mailto:fianaise@proton.me) with a location and, if you can, a photo.
